Data Availability Statement: There are ethical
restrictions on publicly sharing the data which are
imposed by the University of Newcastle Human
Research Ethics Committee (H-2011-0312; H-
2010-1324). The data presented in this manuscript
is from a dataset which involved collection of
sensitive data including information on disease
variables related to cancer and mental health.
Participants provided informed consent on the
understanding that their data would 1) be kept
private and confidential; 2) would be stored
securely on a University of Newcastle server and
only accessed by authorised members of the
research team; 3) be reported in de-identified
aggregate format. Requests for access to a
deidentified copy of the data can, however, be sent
to the University of Newcastle Human Research
Ethics Committee (email: human
ethics@newcastle.edu.au) for their consideration.
